records.summary: Blocked multi-model roundups from overwriting a reviewed release event, aligned Biren aliases to the reviewed entity, preferred verified aliases over funding candidates, and refreshed the First-Line Viewpoints adapter.
checks: 128 Data Center and China-market tests passed
62 Data Center site core tests passed
issues: Business Signals failed Data Center V4 materialization twice
First-Line Viewpoints and Data Center adapter counts diverged
risks: 2026-08-03 production still requires a successful GitHub workflow rerun
lessons: Roundup titles must not enter single-event clustering
Verified aliases must outrank extracted funding candidates
reusable_rules: Reject numbered multi-model roundup titles
Deduplicate identical organization mentions in favor of verified aliases

records.summary: Extended the multi-event roundup gate to translated Chinese titles after the production replay showed the restored intake had already normalized the English headline.
checks: 120 Data Center V4 tests passed including the exact translated title
issues: Production replay still lost Inkling ownership because the roundup title was Chinese at build time
risks: Requires one final production replay
lessons: Source-title eligibility rules must cover the normalized title language used by the builder
reusable_rules: Reject both English and Chinese numbered open-model roundup titles before event clustering

records.summary: Normalized spaced dash variants in source-title translation keys so resumed 2026-08-03 intake reuses an approved translation and passes source-title integrity.
issues: The captured source title used an em dash while the approved translation used a hyphen
producing raw_title_invalid at the pre-commit gate.
risks: Only spaced separator dashes are normalized to avoid collapsing hyphens inside words.
lessons: Normalize publisher separators before translation cache lookup.
reusable_rules: Treat spaced hyphen
en dash
and em dash as the same source-title translation-key separator.

records.summary: Restarted the unresponsive dedicated Community Chrome; collected and published 39 items and 80 links; added automatic CDP-timeout self-healing for future scheduled retries.
checks: Community gate passed with 39 items and 80 links
issues: Chrome HTTP CDP health check passed while the CDP WebSocket session stopped responding.
risks: Restart is restricted to Chrome processes using the dedicated community profile and configured debugging port.
lessons: HTTP CDP availability alone does not prove Playwright session responsiveness.
reusable_rules: On connectOverCDP timeout restart only the dedicated community browser and retry immediately.

records.summary: Raised the periodic report DeepSeek timeout from 180 to 300 seconds after two cloud runs failed at the timeout boundary while the exact local request completed in 80 seconds; added failed child diagnostics to controller output.
checks: Exact local weekly generation succeeded with 219 signals and 33 opinions and 186 community items
issues: Cloud weekly generation failed twice after about 190 seconds with content_generation_failed.
risks: The workflow can now wait up to five minutes for the report model while remaining inside its 45-minute job limit.
lessons: Cloud model latency can exceed local latency and failures must retain child stderr.
reusable_rules: Use a five-minute report-generation timeout and print failed action diagnostics.

records.summary: Published the gate-accepted local DeepSeek weekly report for 2026-08-03 after cloud generations repeatedly failed model-quality validation; the live report and research hub now point to the correct Monday report date.
checks: live title and window and research hub verified
issues: Cloud model retries returned a short title and omitted the first opportunity card community citation.
risks: The rejected 2026-08-02 local draft remains untracked and was excluded from publication.
lessons: A locally validated model artifact is a safe fallback only after the same content gate and deterministic page gates pass.
reusable_rules: Never publish the Sunday-dated scratch report when the official weekly report date is Monday.

records.summary: Recovered the 2026-08-04 V4 funding projection and published three evidence-gated cards without blocked events.
issues: contract value misclassified as funding
entity prefix and same-name research drift
current output self-deduplication
unreviewed MetaX catalog exposure
lessons: canonical V4 event evidence must override secondary research
model validation errors need actionable correction instructions
reusable_rules: exclude current output from historical deduplication
preserve taxonomy decision order
require explicit catalog review before public company/product projection
notes: Windows automation task contract passed in the primary repository; pre-existing dirty files were preserved for recoverable cleanup after deployment.

records.action: Repair weekly Business Signals completion semantics
records.summary: Audited 2026-08-03 through 2026-08-09 failures, decoupled downstream projections from accepted V4 publication, made cloud health dispatch verify target completion, and synchronized split frontstage data
issues: seven first scheduled runs failed
dispatch acceptance was mistaken for cloud completion
application staleness could re-block core V4
split event index drifted 1962 versus 1963
risks: downstream application failures remain warnings and require their owning lane repair
cloud verification waits up to 35 minutes
lessons: controller liveness is not production completion
strict application gates must not discard accepted canonical facts
release tests should reuse the current version constant
reusable_rules: cloud health is green only after target success and same-date origin/main V4 readiness
application projection staleness is visible but non-blocking to core V4

records.summary: Reproduced the cloud wait against an actions/checkout shallow clone contract and replaced ambiguous fetch behavior with an explicit main remote-tracking refspec
issues: git fetch origin main did not guarantee origin/main refresh in shallow GitHub Actions checkouts
risks: health verification intentionally fails closed when the explicit remote ref cannot be refreshed
lessons: a successful fetch command does not prove the remote-tracking ref consumed by later reads was updated
reusable_rules: cloud health fetches must explicitly update the exact remote-tracking ref they inspect

records.summary: Replaced the oversized monolithic frontstage git-show health probe with the bounded split-service manifest after production dry-run evidence showed stdout buffer exhaustion
issues: spawnSync could not buffer the multi-megabyte monolithic frontstage adapter and silently returned an empty frontstage date
risks: health relies on the split manifest whose monolithic consistency is enforced by the existing frontstage regression suite
lessons: health probes should read bounded manifests rather than full serving payloads
reusable_rules: production health inspection must use bounded persisted control artifacts
